descriptions.en: Fermium(II) chloride is a chemical compound with the chemical formula FmCl2. Due to fermium's scarcity and high radioactivity, fermium dichloride has not been synthesized or thoroughly studied in macroscopic quantities. However, theoretical and limited experimental studies suggest possible properties based on its position in the actinide series.
